plain: The study of where words come from.

webster.text: That part of philology which explains the origin and derivation of words, with a view to ascertain their radical or primary signification.

example.quote: This construction is agreeable to its primary etymology.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 17, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
